Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
AuthorDate: Fri Sep 19 11:09:44 2025 +0100
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
CommitDate: Fri Sep 19 11:09:44 2025 +0100

    Bug 1848104 - Botan-3 build code update. [1/1]. r=dandarnell
    
    
    Call Botan's configure.py during configure instead of build.
    
    This properly configuration from build. Additionally, compiler flags
    for Botan can be pulled from the generated build_config.json.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D264506
